Title: S. Thasci Caecili Cypriani Opera omnia (Corpus Scriptorum Ecclesiasticorum Latinorum, vol. III, Pars I-II)
Creator: Cyprian of Carthage; ed. Wilhelm (Guilelmus) Hartel
Publisher: Vindobonae (Vienna): C. Geroldi filium bibliopolam academiae -- Pars I 1868, Pars II 1871; photomechanically reprinted by Johnson Reprint Corporation, New York / London, 1965
Publication Date: 1868 (Pars I) / 1871 (Pars II)
Rights: Public Domain
Language: lat
Source: Mark supplied a compiled docx, 2026-09-05, built from an archive.org-hosted "Full text" / "See other formats" view of a Google Books scan of the 1965 Johnson Reprint Corporation reprint. The exact archive.org item identifier was not stated when the file was supplied -- to be added here once confirmed, per this corpus's own no-guessed-identifier discipline.
Provenance note: Mechanically extracted from the supplied docx -- archive.org/Google Books site-navigation chrome and Google's own standard public-domain usage notice (both present at the head of what was supplied) were stripped; the doubled/tripled inter-word spacing produced by that page's own text export was normalized to single spaces throughout. Nothing else altered -- no OCR error corrected, no apparatus reformatted, no content paraphrased. Rights basis, independently checkable: Hartel's edition (1868/1871) is far past the ~95-year US public-domain-by-date threshold this project's own registry uses; Google's own embedded notice separately treats the scanned copy as public domain; the 1965 Johnson Reprint Corporation printing is a photomechanical reprint of that same public-domain text and creates no new claim over it.
Content note: Covers CSEL 3 Pars I (the treatises, ending with the Sententiae Episcoporum -- the 87 bishops' sentences at the Council of Carthage, 256) and Pars II (Epistulae I-LXXXI) in full; the document ends cleanly at the close of Epistle 81, no truncation found. Does NOT include CSEL 3 Pars III (spuria, the Vita Caecilii Cypriani, and the Acta Proconsularia) -- a separate volume, vendored 2026-09-08 at cyprian_opera-spuria-vita-pontius-lat_hartel-csel3-pars3.txt (Registry row 194; corrected here, independent review Round 18, from an earlier draft that called Pars III still-unacquired and Manifest G1 still open -- G1 is now closed in full, Pars I through III all vendored). OCR quality is uneven by section: the running Latin text of the treatises and letters reads cleanly and coherently throughout every section sampled (including the very end); the apparatus criticus (the dense textual-variant footnotes) carries meaningfully more OCR noise -- garbled manuscript sigla, occasional stray characters -- consistent with how dense critical apparatus typically degrades under OCR even in an otherwise-clean scan. Treat any claim resting on a specific manuscript reading or textual variant (as opposed to the received text itself) as needing independent verification against a second source before use.

ita ut nihil remanserit in illis, et lapis qui percussit imaginem
factus est mons magnus et inpleuit totam terram.

EPISTVLiXV.
CYPRIANVS PRESBYTERIS ET DIACONIS FRATRIBVS S.
Diu patientiam naeam tenui, fratres carissimi, quasi uere- 1
cundum sileutium nostrum proficeret ad quietem. sed cum quo-
i rundam inmoderata et abrupta praesumptio temeritate sm et
touorem martyrum et confessorum pudorem et plebis uniuersae
tranquillitatem turbare conetur, tacere ultra non oportet, ne ad
periculum et plebis pariter et nostrum taciturnitas nimia pro-
cedat. quod enim non periculum metuere debemus de offensa
loDomini, quando aliqui de presbyteris nec euangelii necloci sui
memores, sed neque futurum Domini iudicium neque nunc sibi
praepositum episcopum cogitantes, quod numquam omnino sub

Item in sacerdote Melchisedech sacrificii dominici sacramen- 4
tum praefiguratum uidemus secundum quod scriptura diuina
testatur et dicit: et Melchisedech rex Salem protuLit
panem et uinum. fuit autem sacerdos Dei summi et bene-
sdixit Abraham. quod autem Melchisedech typum Christi por-
taret declarat in psalmis spiritus sanctus ex persona patris ad
filium dicens: ante luciferum genui te, tu es sacerdos
in aeternum secundum ordinem Melchisedech. qui
ordo utique hic est de sacrificio illo ueniens et inde descen-
lodens quod Melchisedech sacerdos Dei summi fuit, quod panem
et uinum optulit, quod Abraham benedixit. nam qui magis
sacerdos Dei summi quam Dominus noster lesus Ghristus, qui
sacrificium Deo patri optulit et optulit hoc idem quod Melchi-
sedech optulerat id est panem et uinuih, suum scilicet cor-
ispus et sanguinem. et circa Abraham benedictio illa praece-
dens ad nostrum populum pertinebat. nam si Abraham Deo
credidit et deputatum est ei ad iustitiam, utique quisque
Deo credit et fide uiuit iustus inuenitur et iam pridem in

1 Faustinus collega noster Lugduni consistens, frater carissime,
semel adque iterum mihi scripsit significans ea quae etiam uobis
scio utique nuntiata tam ab eo quam a ceteris coepiscopis nostris 5

stens Nouatiano se coniunxerit et a catholicae ecclesiae ueritate
adque a corporis nostri et sacerdotii consensione discesserit, te-
nens haereticae praesumptionis durissimam prauitatem, ut seruis
Dei paenitentibus et dolentibus et ad ecclesiam lacrimis etgemituio
et dolore pulsantibus diuinae pietatis et lenitatis paternae solacia
et subsidia cludantur nec ad fouenda uulnera admittantur uul-
nerati, sed sine spe pacis et communicationis relicti ad luporum
rapinam et praedam diaboli proiciantur. cui rei nostrum est con-
sulere et subuenire, frater carissime, qui diuinam clementiamw
cogitantes et gubernandae ecclesiae libram tenentes sic censuram
uigoris peccatoribus exhibemus, ut tamen lapsis erigendis et
curandis uulneratis bonitatis et misericordiae diuinae medicinam
non denegemus.

et contra ecclesiam baptizandos foris opinatur. quale est autem,
ut quia hoc Nouatianus facere audet, nos putemus non esse
faciendum? quid ergo? quia et honorem cathedrae sacerdotalis 5
Nouatianus usurpat, num idcirco nos cathedrae renuntiare debe-
mus? et quia Nouatianus altare conlocare et sacrificia offerre
contra fas nititur, ab altari et sacrificiis cessare nos oportet, ne
paria et similia cum illo celebrare uideamur? uanum prorsus et
stultum est, ut quia Nouatianus extra ecclesiam uindicat sibi 10
ueritatis imaginem, relinquat ecclesia ueritatem.
